items.title: Solana Foundation hires Binance, Polygon veterans as it ramps up tokenized finance push
items.whyYouShouldCare: The hiring of experienced professionals from Binance and Polygon signals Solana's commitment to enhancing its tokenized finance capabilities, potentially increasing ecosystem activity.

items.title: Solana Foundation hires ex-Binance CMO and payments exec as new partnerships expand
items.whyYouShouldCare: Bringing in a former Binance CMO to drive partnerships could enhance Solana's market presence and attract new users and projects to its ecosystem.

items.title: Solana DEX volume spike hides circular trades, and automated bots are blamed
items.whyYouShouldCare: The spike in DEX volume, attributed to circular trades and bots, raises concerns about the reliability of trading data, which could impact liquidity perceptions on Solana.
